parsed.rationale: A newly invited analyst receives an 'access denied' message after accepting the invite, while other users can log in normally, indicating a workspace access/permission issue that likely requires human troubleshooting.

parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the details—sorry for the trouble here. Since only the newly invited analyst is seeing an “access denied” message after accepting the invite (and other users can log in normally), this looks like a workspace access/permission issue for that specific user.

I’ve escalated this for human review so the team can troubleshoot and restore her access. While that’s in progress, can you please share the following so we can move faster:
1) The analyst’s email address (or username) that is receiving the access denied message
2) The exact wording of the “access denied” message (and any error code, if shown)
3) Which workspace she’s trying to access (workspace name/ID)

Once we have that, we’ll continue the investigation and work to get her access back today.
